label: Croatia
trip: Two trips in 2023. Trip 1, May 28 to June 2 (solo): fly Istanbul > Dubrovnik 28th, a day in Dubrovnik's old town, Krilo catamaran to Split that evening; Split 28-31 (Klis 29th, skipped his flight on the 30th to stay); bus Split > Dubrovnik 31st; Dubrovnik 31 May-2 June (Lokrum 1st); fly out via Istanbul 2nd. Zagreb: one night in transit, Aug 20-21 (Basel > Zagreb flight, bus on to Ljubljana). Trip 2, Aug 27 to 31 (with his friend Jordan): fly Budapest > Split and ferry to Hvar 27th; Hvar 27-29; ferry Hvar > Split 29th; Split 29-31 (Blue Lagoon/Trogir boat tour 30th); bus Split > Dubrovnik 31st, sunset at the Buža bars, night bus on to Kotor (Montenegro)

pages.note: HTML from the Guatemala pre-photo template; one week on the Dalmatian coast in the route map's order and days: Split 3 (Klis, the Blue Lagoon/Trogir boat day) > ferry 1 hr > Hvar 2 > ferry 3.5 hr > Dubrovnik 2 (Lokrum), with ways to stretch it to 10 days (Krka, a third Hvar day, the Pakleni Islands); Kevin never took the Hvar > Dubrovnik ferry (he went back via Split and the bus), say so; Kotor (Montenegro) and Mostar (Bosnia) as extensions linking the LIVE field notes only; Zagreb, Plitvice, Zadar, Istria and the other islands as 'if you have more time' (Kevin only spent a transit night in Zagreb and has not been to the others)

two visits: May 2023 solo at Booze & Snooze, Aug 2023 with a friend at the Cornaro Hotel; Klis Fortress and the Blue Lagoon/Trogir boat tour as their own sections; Krka is field-notes advice only (he has not been); the Split > Hvar ferry is told once, in hvar.html, link it

Aug 27-29, 2023; rain cancelled the boat tours, so an honest shorter guide: the ferry from Split, the fortress at sunset, Dalmatino, Dva Ribara, Hula Hula, the bar crawl, Hostel Villa Skansi; the Pakleni Islands, Carpe Diem and the scooter loop are field-notes advice he did not get to

three passes: the arrival day May 28 (walls, Rector's Palace, Franciscan pharmacy, Jesuit Stairs, Lovrijenac), May 31-June 2 (Revelin, Lokrum, Hostel Angelina) and the Aug 31 sunset at the Buža bars before the night bus to Kotor; Lokrum as its own section; Mount Srđ and the Homeland War Museum are field-notes advice only (no journal visit); onward links to the LIVE Montenegro and Bosnia field notes only
